### Glossary

- **WSGI application**: A Python callable that a web server calls once per request with the request data and a function to start the reply. [`src/flask/app.py:1479-1536`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/app.py#L1479-L1536)
- **Endpoint**: The name of a route, used to find its view function and to build its URL. [`src/flask/sansio/app.py:613-615`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/app.py#L613-L615)
- **URL rule**: A URL pattern such as `/post/<int:id>` plus the methods it accepts, stored in the app's routing map. [`src/flask/sansio/app.py:650-653`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/app.py#L650-L653)
- **View function**: Your function that handles a request for one endpoint and returns something Flask can turn into a response. [`src/flask/sansio/app.py:654-661`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/app.py#L654-L661)
- **Scaffold**: The shared base class of `Flask` and `Blueprint` that owns the route decorators and the hook registries. [`src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py:52-68`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py#L52-L68)
- **Scope key**: The key under which a hook is filed: `None` means 'every request', a blueprint name means 'requests handled by that blueprint'. [`src/flask/typing.py:49`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/typing.py#L49)
- **Setup method**: A registration method (route, errorhandler, before_request...) that is only allowed before the app serves its first request. [`src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py:42-49`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py#L42-L49)
- **Blueprint**: A bundle of routes and hooks that is defined without an app and copied onto one later. [`src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py:119-133`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py#L119-L133)
- **Deferred function**: A small function a blueprint stores so it can apply a registration to an app later. [`src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py:223-230`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py#L223-L230)
- **Application context**: The state that says 'this app is the current one', which makes `current_app` and `g` usable. [`src/flask/ctx.py:238-254`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/ctx.py#L238-L254)
- **Request context**: The state for the request being handled now, which makes `request` and `session` usable. [`src/flask/ctx.py:367-394`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/ctx.py#L367-L394)
- **Context-local proxy**: A global-looking object (`request`, `g`, `current_app`, `session`) that looks up the real object for the current request each time you touch it. [`src/flask/globals.py:28-51`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/globals.py#L28-L51)
- **g**: A scratch object for your own data that lasts as long as the app context, which in a request means one request. [`src/flask/ctx.py:29-66`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/ctx.py#L29-L66)
- **Session**: A dict that survives between requests from the same browser. [`src/flask/sessions.py:298-315`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sessions.py#L298-L315)
- **Null session**: A stand-in session used when no secret key is set: reading works, writing raises an error that tells you to set the key. [`src/flask/sessions.py:97-111`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sessions.py#L97-L111)
- **Hook (request callback)**: A function Flask calls at a fixed point of every request: before, after, or at teardown. [`src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py:459-539`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py#L459-L539)
- **Error handler**: A function registered for an HTTP status code or an exception class that turns an error into a response. [`src/flask/sansio/app.py:823-846`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/app.py#L823-L846)
- **Response conversion**: The rules that turn whatever a view returns (string, dict, tuple, Response...) into a real Response object. [`src/flask/app.py:1129-1137`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/app.py#L1129-L1137)
- **Signal**: A broadcast that Flask sends at key moments so other code can listen without changing the result. [`src/flask/signals.py:6-17`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/signals.py#L6-L17)
- **Context processor**: A function whose returned dict is added to the variables of every template rendered. [`src/flask/templating.py:24-36`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/templating.py#L24-L36)
- **JSON provider**: The object at `app.json` that does all JSON work for the app: dumping, loading and building JSON responses. [`src/flask/json/provider.py:124-163`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/json/provider.py#L124-L163)
- **Tagged JSON**: A JSON format that marks non-JSON values (tuples, bytes, datetimes, UUIDs, Markup) with a short tag so they round-trip. [`src/flask/json/tag.py:219-247`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/json/tag.py#L219-L247)
- **Instance folder**: A per-deployment folder, outside the package, for config files and data such as a SQLite database. [`src/flask/sansio/app.py:510-521`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/app.py#L510-L521)
- **Sans-IO**: Code that does no I/O (it never reads a request or writes a response) and never uses the Flask globals, so another framework can reuse it. [`src/flask/sansio/README.md:1-6`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/README.md#L1-L6)
- **ensure_sync**: The method that makes an `async def` function callable from Flask's synchronous code. [`src/flask/app.py:966-978`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/app.py#L966-L978)
- **ScriptInfo**: The object the `flask` command carries around to find, import and cache your app. [`src/flask/cli.py:293-331`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/cli.py#L293-L331)
- **Debug mode**: A development setting that shows tracebacks in the browser, reloads on code changes and re-raises errors instead of returning a 500. [`src/flask/sansio/app.py:549-567`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/sansio/app.py#L549-L567)
- **ConfigAttribute**: A class attribute on the app that reads and writes a config key, so `app.testing` is `app.config['TESTING']`. [`src/flask/config.py:20-47`](https://github.com/pallets/flask/blob/85c5d93cbd049c4bd0679c36fd1ddcae8c37b642/src/flask/config.py#L20-L47)
